name: aiPHeed five-trigger food-stress risk forecast (E44 final candidate, I2)
status: EXPERIMENTAL - FORECASTING ACCEPTANCE NOT MET; enabled only with AIPHEED_LEAD2_MODEL=e44

information.rule: only data published before the origin (E43/E44 protocols)

indicator.name: Food-Stress Risk Probability (exploratory)
indicator.definition: Probability that the province is in concurrent elevated food stress in the target quarter (target T43): SWS self-rated hunger in Balance Luzon above 11.3% (regional) AND the province's PSA food inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile, or food minus headline inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile. Estimated by the E44 five-trigger component model. Exploratory food-stress outcome; not independently verified household food insecurity.
indicator.horizon: Lead 2: issued 2026-10-01 (latest completed quarter 2026-Q3) for 2027-Q1; experimental (E44)
indicator.source: SWS Balance Luzon hunger; PSA provincial food and headline CPI and wholesale rice; NOAA typhoon tracks and ENSO; PSA palay/corn and fisheries production; PSA LFS (national); BSP remittances and ECB USD/PHP (national); province-attributed news
indicator.caveat: Forecasting acceptance (75% Lead-2 accuracy with balanced discrimination) was not met. Exploratory estimate; not an official classification.

scoreTypes.food_stress_risk_probability: Probability that the province is in concurrent elevated food stress in the target quarter (target T43): SWS self-rated hunger in Balance Luzon above 11.3% (regional) AND the province's PSA food inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile, or food minus headline inflation above its 2021-2022 60th percentile. Estimated by the E44 five-trigger component model. Exploratory food-stress outcome; not independently verified household food insecurity.

operationalRules.band: Low if P < 0.33; Watch if 0.33 <= P < 0.67; High if P >= 0.67
operationalRules.decision: HIGH/LOW decision at the threshold selected inside training (E44 PROTOCOL 3)
operationalRules.alert: Alert candidate when the band is High; staged for administrator confirmation.
operationalRules.municipal: No municipal probability; LGU rankings are relative prioritization.

PH040100000.name: Cavite

forecast.explanation: Cavite, 2027-Q1: estimated probability of concurrent elevated food stress 19% (Low; decision LOW at the training-selected threshold 0.2). Regional hunger is forecast at 20.6% (chance above 11.3%: 96%); Cavite's food inflation is forecast at 2.8% (chance its price signal is on: 26%).

PH040100000.fiveTriggerNote: Contributions of each trigger group to the food-inflation and hunger forecasts of the served model (model attributions, not proof that an event causes food insecurity). Employment and OFW indicators are national, so they shift every province equally.

market.evidence: food and headline CPI enter the served price component
market.evidenceNote: Food inflation 2.5% in the latest two months vs this province's reference 4.71%; food minus headline -2.1 points.

climate.evidence: typhoons, ENSO, palay/corn shown; used by the five-trigger LightGBM, not by the served model
climate.evidenceNote: 0.0 typhoon(s) within 300 km in 2026-Q3; ENSO El Nino in the previous quarter; palay production -18.2% year on year.

fish_kill.evidenceNote: Fisheries production 8.3% and aquaculture 55.2% year on year (2026-Q2); no official fish-kill event series.

employment.evidenceNote: National unemployment 4.79% (2026-Q2), 0.9 points year on year; national figure, the same for every province.

ofw_remittance.evidenceNote: National cash remittances n/a year on year (latest 2025-Q4); USD/PHP 8.35%; national figure.

climate.source: NOAA IBTrACS and CPC ONI (not PAGASA); PSA palay/corn production

fisheries.source: PSA fisheries production (no BFAR fish-kill event series)

ofwRemittance.source: BSP cash remittances curated in bsp_macro.parquet (national; unverified re-download); ECB USD/PHP

PH040100000.pastForecastsNote: Development backtest of the I2 procedure at each past origin (information available then); not forecasts issued live at the time.
warnings: FORECASTING ACCEPTANCE NOT MET: no E44 iteration reached 75% Lead-2 accuracy with balanced discrimination; treat as experimental decision support.
SWS hunger is regional; provinces differ through food prices and provincial trigger data.
Employment and OFW evidence are national.
Exploratory food-stress outcome; not verified household food insecurity.

KNOWN DEFECT (found in E46): I2 compares a residual-corrected food-inflation projection with an uncorrected headline projection, which overstates the food-minus-headline gap (+3.1 points on average) and raises the price-signal probability; its decision threshold is refitted at every origin on a few labels. Probabilities are kept as frozen; see E46 FINAL_REPORT.
